    Weight gradings of the mesh derivative cokernels #

    weights-and-parameters.tex: "a mesh weight w grades V_{m+1}(C) by giving a path at row v the weight w(path) − ν_v, and grades U_m(C) by giving a path parallel to an arrow a the weight w(path) − w(a). The map D_m preserves these gradings, because each term (σa)a of the mesh at v has weight ν_v. Hence coker D_m is graded by L, and the line k[p_i] has degree χ_i."

    Over any commutative coefficient ring: for an integer mesh weight W (IntWt), the weight projections of families (projW, projWA) commute with D_m (D_projWA), so the image of D_m is graded (projW_mem_imageD), and a row is homogeneous of degree W(p) − ν_v (projW_row). This gives the labels χ_i of Lemma B.2 (integralMeshCokernels_graded).

                theorem MultiplicativeBasisDeformations.ScalarMeshCategory.integralMeshCokernels_weights {V : Type v} [Quiver V] {Q : TranslationQuiver V} {k : Type u} [CommRing k] [(x : V) → Fintype ((y : V) × (y ⟶ x))] (c : MeshCoefficients k Q) (W : IntWt Q) [DecidableEq V] [DecidablePred fun (x : V) => x ∈ Q.nonprojective] {m : ℕ} (l : ℤ) :
                (∀ g ∈ imageD c m, projW c W l g ∈ imageD c m) ∧ ∀ (x : ↑Q.nonprojective) (p : Quiver.Path ↑(Q.tau x) ↑x), projW c W l (row c x p) = if W.pw p - W.ν x = l then row c x p else 0

                The weight labels of Lemma B.2: over 𝒪 = ℤ/4 (or any coefficient ring), for every integer mesh weight W the cokernel of D_m is W-graded (the image of D_m is graded), and the class of a row p_i at v_i is homogeneous of degree χ_i(W) = W(p_i) − ν_{v_i} (eq:parameter-character). With integralMeshCokernels this is ⊕_{m≥2} coker D_m(E₄) ≅ ⊕_{i∈I} (𝒪/(2))_{χ_i}.
